main_body: Open bookcase frame with 4 shelf compartments holding scrolls, books and small items, drawn flat from the front
top_band: light tan rows 1-2 across the top, then a mid-orange frame row at row 3; no real horizontal surface
evidence: In a middle column the light tan top band is only about 2 rows and reads as a cap line. Below it is the face-on frame and the dark maroon interior. Shelf boards are 1-2 row orange strips seen edge-on, so none of their top surfaces are visible from above. There is no distinct front-edge line and no eave shadow. Compartments are flat dark panels with only a faint inner edge. This matches the guide's 'front elevation: top 1' and 'rim only' failures.

style.evidence: The wood frame has about 3-4 tones (light tan, orange, mid, dark), which is thinner than the 5-6 steps in the references. The interior compartments are large flat maroon areas of one colour with no grain or speckle. The outer edge is a neutral dark grey-blue at the bottom and sides rather than a clearly material-tinted brown. The small items (scrolls, books, cloth) add some detail, but most tiles carry only 2-4 colours, so the piece looks flatter than the stall and well references.
